g.text: Is stronger annotated emotion associated with easier classification?
Non-neutral clips; class-balanced models. Squares additionally adjust for clip duration.
Native scales differ: coefficients belong to their own dataset and are never pooled.
Intervals are withheld with fewer than 20 source clusters.
DailyTalk: 93 dialogues but only 2 actors; intervals are conditional, not evidence for new speakers.
Positive coefficients concern classification accuracy, not the model's ability to estimate emotion intensity.
